user.title: GLaDOS
user.description: Add GLaDOS to this home. She will be unbearable about it. Voices, sounds and the speaking schedule can be changed afterwards under Configure.

abort.single_instance_allowed: GLaDOS is already installed. One is plenty.

data.chat_agent: Chat agent (answers when you talk to her)
data.voice_agent: Voice agent (rewrites facts in her voice)

data_description.chat_agent: The GLaDOS agent passes each sentence to this agent and cleans its reply for speech. Not GLaDOS itself.
data_description.routine_minutes: Minutes from alarm to the door, for people without their own Morning routine helper.

clean_text.name: Clean text for speech
clean_text.description: Makes text safe for the text-to-speech voice: emoji, quotes and markdown removed, units and minus signs spelled out.

say.name: Say in her voice
say.description: Rewrites plain facts in GLaDOS's voice and cleans them for speech. Falls back to the facts.

task.name: Task
task.description: An extra job, such as adding a clothing tip.

room_context.name: Room context
room_context.description: Everything about one room: people, occupancy, sleep, quiet, climate, windows, heaters, coolers and free voice satellites.

area.name: Area
area.description: Empty for the room people are in.

announce.name: Announce
announce.description: Says something unprompted in the right room, only when polite. GLaDOS rewrites the facts; the Announcer reads them as written.

area.name: Area
area.description: Room to speak in. Empty: where people are.

ignore_schedule.name: Ignore schedule
ignore_schedule.description: Speak outside the speaking schedule. Sleep and quiet rules still apply.

anywhere.name: Any room if none here
anywhere.description: Use a free satellite elsewhere when the room has none.

glados_after.name: GLaDOS chimes in
glados_after.description: With the Announcer: a task for one GLaDOS remark right after.

who.name: Who
who.description: Works out which person is meant (a name, the user asking, or the only one home) and returns their room, phones, leave time, routine minutes and own list.

person.name: Person
person.description: Name; empty for the person asking.

remember.name: Remember
remember.description: Stores one value under a key, with the time it was stored.

recall.name: Recall
recall.description: Returns a remembered value and when it was stored.
